desc: Implement input parsing; if H > W, transpose the grid and remap directions (L↔U, R↔D) so that H ≤ W always; track pointer (h,w) in transposed coordinates.
Build initial arrays: Lpre[j] for j=0..W via forward recurrence; Rrow[j] for j=W+1 down to 1 via backward recurrence; store as lists of lists, all mod 998244353.
Implement apply_T / apply_Tt as tight O(s) loops with local variable references.

Query loop: move pointer, apply update A[ptr]=a_i, recompute Lpre[j] from Lpre[j-1] (and Rrow[j] from Rrow[j+1] when arriving via L-move), answer = dot(Rrow[j+1], Lpre[j]); handle edge columns j=1 (Lpre[0]=e₁) and j=W (Rrow[W+1]=e_H).
Optimize I/O: sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(); accumulate outputs and join.
Test against both provided samples; brute-force check small random grids vs naive full-DP recomputation after each query.
